# mergegateway_organization_settings (Resource)

Manages the settings of the organization the management key belongs to. The organization always exists, so this resource never creates or deletes anything: creating it updates the settings in its config, settings left out keep their current values, and destroying it only removes it from the Terraform state, leaving the settings as they are. Declare it at most once.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The settings of the organization the management key belongs to. Settings
# left out keep their current values. Destroying this resource leaves the
# settings as they are.
resource "mergegateway_organization_settings" "this" {
  log_payloads        = false
  zero_data_retention = true
  web_search_mode     = "auto"

  tag_definitions = [
    { key = "team", values = ["support", "sales"] },
  ]

  vendor_restrictions = {
    allowed_vendors           = ["openai", "anthropic"]
    vendor_routing_preference = ["anthropic", "openai"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_handle_model_deprecations` (Boolean) Whether to move routing policies off deprecated models automatically. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value.
- `log_payloads` (Boolean) Whether to store request and response bodies. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value.
- `name` (String) The organization's name. The API trims surrounding whitespace. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value.
- `tag_definitions` (Attributes List) The request tag keys and the values each allows, kept in the order given. `[]` removes them all. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tag_definitions))
- `vendor_restrictions` (Attributes) Which vendors and regions the organization's traffic may use. It is set as a whole: attributes left out of the block take their defaults. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vendor_restrictions))
- `web_search_mode` (String) How web search runs: `auto`, `native` or `merge`. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value.
- `zero_data_retention` (Boolean) Whether to route only to vendors that retain no data. Leave it out to keep the organization's current value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the organization was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The organization's ID.
- `slug` (String) Set when the organization is created. It does not change.

<a id="nestedatt--tag_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tag_definitions`

Required:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `values` (List of String) The values the key allows.


<a id="nestedatt--vendor_restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vendor_restrictions`

Optional:

- `allowed_regions` (List of String) The only regions requests may be served from. Defaults to none.
- `allowed_vendors` (List of String) The only vendors requests may be served by. Defaults to none.
- `byok_only` (Boolean) Use only the organization's own credentials. Defaults to `false`.
- `customer_key_usage_default` (String) The default key usage for end customers without their own setting: `use_any`, `prefer_byok`, `byok_only` or `customer_only`. Leave it out to have customers follow `prefer_byok` and `byok_only`.
- `ignored_regions` (List of String) The regions requests are never served from. Defaults to none.
- `ignored_vendors` (List of String) The vendors requests are never served by. Defaults to none.
- `prefer_byok` (Boolean) Prefer the organization's own credentials over Merge-managed access. Defaults to `false`.
- `vendor_routing_preference` (List of String) The vendors to prefer, most preferred first. Defaults to none.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# There is one organization per management key, so any ID imports its settings.
terraform import mergegateway_organization_settings.this organization
```
